strategy_roster.name: Macd Secrets
strategy_roster.entry_long: macd(close,12,26) > macd_signal(close,12,26,9) and ema(close,6) > ema(close,85) and roc(close,14) > 0
strategy_roster.exit_long: macd(close,12,26) < macd_signal(close,12,26,9) or ema(close,6) < ema(close,85) or roc(close,14) < 0
strategy_roster.notes: MACD(12,26,9), EMA(6/85), and positive 14-bar ROC retain the documented current-timeframe momentum, baseline, and deviation checks. Higher-timeframe MACD/LWMA/momentum context, point targets, and single-position risk handling are not expressible.

strategy_roster.name: Distance to Demand Vector
strategy_roster.notes: The 100-bar prior high/low midpoint is an explicit distance-and-direction proxy for the unavailable long and short demand vectors. Vector calculations, 1-minute timeframe, and opposite-side handling are omitted; no stops are documented.

strategy_roster.name: ADX DMI
strategy_roster.notes: A close/EMA(14) cross with ADX confirmation proxies the documented -DI/+DI directional crossover, with the inverse as exit. DMI lines, optional close toggles, and external stop management are not available.

strategy_roster.name: EMA RSI Trail Stop
strategy_roster.entry_long: crossabove(ema(close,10),ema(close,20)) and ema(close,20) > ema(close,100) and close > open
strategy_roster.notes: EMA(10/20/100), the bullish candle filter, and RSI(14)>70 exit retain the documented trend/RSI rules. The fixed 5% stop is retained; point trailing, 24-bar timer, and short-side settings are omitted.

strategy_roster.name: ColorMaRsi Trigger MMRec Duplex
strategy_roster.notes: EMA(5/10) and RSI(3/13) alignment are the documented long-block composite values and produce a bullish trigger. Separate short block, applied-price variants, MMRec volume history, 1000/2000-point protections, and signal-bar shifts are not representable.

strategy_roster.name: TCP Pivot Reversal Limit
strategy_roster.notes: A lower-range rejection with a bullish close is a stateless proxy for a failed downside pivot and reversal. Daily pivot formulas, target mode, hourly timing, trailing, and point stops are not expressible.

strategy_roster.name: Regularities of Exchange Rates
strategy_roster.notes: A prior 10-bar high break is a price-action proxy for the scheduled two-sided stop-order bracket. Opening/closing hours, broker-point offsets, 500-point stop, 20-point target, and pending-order cancellation are not DSL fields.

strategy_roster.name: Close By Equity Percent
strategy_roster.notes: The source is an equity-only position manager and has no entry signal, so an impossible negative-price guard avoids fabricating exposure. Balance/equity comparison, 1.2x threshold, reference updates, and minute scheduling are unavailable.

strategy_roster.name: TraderToolEA Manual Panel (StockSharp Port)
strategy_roster.notes: The source is a manual command panel rather than an autonomous signal, so no deterministic entry is fabricated. Button toggles, Level1 order management, grids, pip stops, virtual trailing, and break-even state are unsupported.

strategy_roster.name: Hull MA Slope Mean Reversion
strategy_roster.notes: EMA(9) turning through SMA(9) with RSI(14)<40 is an explicit Hull-slope/RSI oversold proxy. Hull(9), deviation 2x, ATR(14) stop, and 5-minute execution are unavailable; no percentage protection is set.
